test_title: PYST 15: SSC JE CE - Reasoning (Held on: 23 Mar 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Thomas, Jack, Harry, Sam, Yash and Jason are sitting equidistant from each other around a round table facing towards the centre.

(a) Yash is sitting to the right of Sam.

(b) Harry is sitting between Thomas and Jack.

(c) Jason is sitting between sam and Thomas.

Who is sitting to the left of Jack?
solution:
According to the given information,

I. Thomas, Jack, Harry, Sam, Yash and Jason are sitting at a round table facing towards the center.

II. Yash is sitting to the right of Sam.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e9f4ca70741c362e01572495f223ba1a311bf0ac8003b0b54008598de753bdf.png] 

III. Jason is sitting between Sam and Thomas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5085c8f9d4d44314330c01badc38d16f4c09627fbe5758eac4a7d0785ad8c8ee.png] 

IV. Harry is sitting between Thomas and Jack.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30156e8582480e17e250be2c38c0baff4796b0128b2bf2c70f977853481e7e2d.png] 

Here we can that **"Yash" is sitting to the left of "Jack".**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Yash"**.
